; The federal figures for each tax year this build carries: the standard
; deduction, the limits and phase-outs the worksheets use, the credit
; amounts and the tax rate schedules. Each 2025 figure names the part of the
; published source that prints it; the sources are in sources/catalog/us.
;
; Public Law 119-21 changed several 2025 figures after Rev. Proc. 2024-40
; published them (the standard deduction, the child tax credit and the
; state and local tax limit), so those are taken from the 2025 Form 1040
; instructions, which print the figures as amended.
;
; A year without figures of its own is given 2025's. The 2026 figures, from
; Rev. Proc. 2025-32, are not yet in the source catalog.
(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxcalcs.returns.v1 'ret)

(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxprotos.us.federal.v1 'fed)

(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxprotos.facts.v1 'facts)

(use-proto 'nexteggapp.taxprotos.common.v1 'common)

; Household, age attainment (January 1 rule), filing status eligibility and
; resolution (26 U.S.C. §§ 1, 2, 7703), and Section 152 dependency and Child
; Tax Credit / Other Dependent Credit tests (26 U.S.C. §§ 24, 152).
(def person-age-end-of-year ((dob Date) (tax-year Int)) Int :cite ((law "26 C.F.R." "1.152-1") (doc "us-irs-rev-rul-2003-72")) (withs (yr (date-year dob) mo (date-month dob) dy (date-day dob)) (if (<= yr 0) 0 (if (and (is mo 1) (is dy 1)) (+ (- tax-year yr) 1) (- tax-year yr)))))

(def born-before-65-cutoff? ((dob Date) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "63" "(f)(1)")) (>= (person-age-end-of-year dob tax-year) 65))

(def valid-employment-ssn? ((tin ret/TaxpayerID)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "24" "(h)(7)")) (all-of (is (. tin 'kind) 'ret/TAXPAYER_ID_KIND_SSN) (. tin 'valid_for_employment)))

(def valid-dependent-tin? ((tin ret/TaxpayerID)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "24" "(h)(4)") (law "26 U.S.C." "151" "(e)")) (any-of (is (. tin 'kind) 'ret/TAXPAYER_ID_KIND_SSN) (is (. tin 'kind) 'ret/TAXPAYER_ID_KIND_ITIN) (is (. tin 'kind) 'ret/TAXPAYER_ID_KIND_ATIN)))

(def qualifying-child-relationship? ((rel ret/Relationship)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(c)(2)")) (any-of (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_CHILD) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_STEPCHILD) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_FOSTER_CHILD) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_GRANDCHILD) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_SIBLING) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_HALF_SIBLING) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_STEPSIBLING) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_NIECE_OR_NEPHEW) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_OTHER_DESCENDANT_OF_SIBLING)))

(def qualifying-relative-relationship-or-household? ((dep ret/Dependent)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(d)(2)")) (withs (rel (. dep 'relationship)) (any-of (qualifying-child-relationship? rel) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_PARENT) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_STEPPARENT) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_GRANDPARENT) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_AUNT_OR_UNCLE) (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_IN_LAW) (all-of (is rel 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_NOT_RELATED) (is (. dep 'months_lived_with_you) 12)))))

(def passes-joint-return-test? ((dep ret/Dependent)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(b)(2)")) (any-of (not (. dep 'files_joint_return)) (. dep 'joint_return_only_for_refund)))

(def passes-citizen-test? ((dep ret/Dependent)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(b)(3)")) (. dep 'citizen_or_resident_of_north_america))

(def qualifying-child-core? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(c)")) (withs (age (person-age-end-of-year (. dep 'date_of_birth) tax-year) age-ok (any-of (< age 19) (all-of (< age 24) (. dep 'full_time_student)) (. dep 'permanently_disabled)) residency-ok (any-of (> (. dep 'months_lived_with_you) 6) (is (. dep 'custodial_release) 'ret/CUSTODIAL_RELEASE_RELEASED_TO_YOU))) (all-of (qualifying-child-relationship? (. dep 'relationship)) age-ok residency-ok (not (. dep 'provided_over_half_own_support)) (passes-joint-return-test? dep) (passes-citizen-test? dep))))

(def qualifying-child? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(c)") (law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(e)")) (all-of (qualifying-child-core? dep tax-year) (not (. dep 'not_claimed)) (not (is (. dep 'custodial_release) 'ret/CUSTODIAL_RELEASE_RELEASED_BY_YOU))))

(def ctc-qualifying-child? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "24" "(c)") (law "26 U.S.C." "24" "(h)(7)")) (all-of (qualifying-child? dep tax-year) (< (person-age-end-of-year (. dep 'date_of_birth) tax-year) 17) (valid-employment-ssn? (. dep 'tin))))

(def qualifying-relative? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(d)")) (all-of (not (qualifying-child-core? dep tax-year)) (not (. dep 'qualifying_child_of_another_taxpayer)) (qualifying-relative-relationship-or-household? dep) (< (. dep 'gross_income) (. p 'qr_gross_income_limit)) (any-of (. dep 'you_provided_over_half_support) (. dep 'multiple_support_agreement)) (passes-joint-return-test? dep) (passes-citizen-test? dep) (not (. dep 'not_claimed))))

(def odc-qualifying-dependent? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "24" "(h)(4)")) (all-of (valid-dependent-tin? (. dep 'tin)) (any-of (all-of (qualifying-child? dep tax-year) (not (ctc-qualifying-child? dep tax-year))) (qualifying-relative? dep tax-year p))))

(def claimed-dependent? ((dep ret/Dependent) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "152" "(a)")) (all-of (valid-dependent-tin? (. dep 'tin)) (any-of (qualifying-child? dep tax-year) (qualifying-relative? dep tax-year p))))

(def count-ctc-children ((deps (Slice ret/Dependent)) (tax-year Int)) Int (len (keep (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (ctc-qualifying-child? d tax-year)) deps)))

(def count-odc-dependents ((deps (Slice ret/Dependent)) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) Int (len (keep (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (odc-qualifying-dependent? d tax-year p)) deps)))

(def has-hoh-qualifying-person? ((hh ret/Household) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "2" "(b)(1)")) (withs (deps (. hh 'dependents)) (any-of (some (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (all-of (> (. d 'months_lived_with_you) 6) (any-of (qualifying-child-core? d tax-year) (all-of (qualifying-relative? d tax-year p) (not (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_NOT_RELATED)))))) deps) (all-of (. hh 'paid_over_half_cost_of_parents_home) (some (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (all-of (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_PARENT) (qualifying-relative? d tax-year p))) deps)))))

(def eligible-for-qss? ((hh ret/Household) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "2" "(a)")) (withs (died-yr (date-year (. hh 'earlier_spouse_died_on)) deps (. hh 'dependents)) (all-of (is (. hh 'marital_status) 'ret/MARITAL_STATUS_WIDOWED) (any-of (is died-yr (- tax-year 1)) (is died-yr (- tax-year 2))) (. hh 'paid_over_half_cost_of_home) (some (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (all-of (is (. d 'months_lived_with_you) 12) (any-of (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_CHILD) (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_STEPCHILD)) (qualifying-child? d tax-year))) deps))))

(def considered-unmarried-for-hoh? ((hh ret/Household) (tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "7703" "(b)")) (all-of (is (. hh 'marital_status) 'ret/MARITAL_STATUS_MARRIED) (. hh 'spouse_absent_last_six_months) (. hh 'paid_over_half_cost_of_home) (some (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (all-of (> (. d 'months_lived_with_you) 6) (any-of (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_CHILD) (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_STEPCHILD) (is (. d 'relationship) 'ret/RELATIONSHIP_FOSTER_CHILD)) (qualifying-child? d tax-year))) (. hh 'dependents))))

(def resolve-filing-status ((hh ret/Household) (elections ret/Elections) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) fed/FilingStatus :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "1") (law "26 U.S.C." "2") (law "26 U.S.C." "7703")) (withs (elected (. elections 'filing_status) marital (. hh 'marital_status)) (cond ((is elected 'ret/FILING_STATUS_ELECTION_SINGLE) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE) ((is elected 'ret/FILING_STATUS_ELECTION_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) ((is elected 'ret/FILING_STATUS_ELECTION_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) ((is elected 'ret/FILING_STATUS_ELECTION_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) ((is elected 'ret/FILING_STATUS_ELECTION_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) ((is marital 'ret/MARITAL_STATUS_MARRIED) (if (considered-unmarried-for-hoh? hh tax-year) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY)) ((eligible-for-qss? hh tax-year) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) ((and (. hh 'paid_over_half_cost_of_home) (has-hoh-qualifying-person? hh tax-year p)) 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (else 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE))))

; The name as on the Social Security card: first name, middle initial, last
; name and suffix.
(def person-full-name ((person ret/Person)) String (join-words (slice (. person 'first_name) (. person 'middle_initial) (. person 'last_name) (. person 'suffix))))

; A dependent's name: first name, last name and suffix.
(def dependent-full-name ((d ret/Dependent)) String (join-words (slice (. d 'first_name) (. d 'last_name) (. d 'suffix))))

(def lookup-dependent-by-id ((hh ret/Household) (dep-id String)) ret/Dependent (fold (fn ((acc ret/Dependent) (d ret/Dependent)) ret/Dependent (if (is (. d 'id) dep-id) d acc)) (proto 'ret/Dependent) (. hh 'dependents)))

(def build-party-for-person ((person ret/Person)) common/Party (proto 'common/Party :name (person-full-name person) :tin (. person 'tin.number)))

(def build-form1040-dependents ((deps (Slice ret/Dependent)) (tax-year Int) (p FederalYear)) (Slice fed/Dependent) (map (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) fed/Dependent (proto 'fed/Dependent :name (dependent-full-name d) :tin (. d 'tin.number) :child_tax_credit (ctc-qualifying-child? d tax-year) :credit_for_other_dependents (odc-qualifying-dependent? d tax-year p))) (keep (fn ((d ret/Dependent)) Bool (claimed-dependent? d tax-year p)) deps)))

; Form W-2 wages, Schedule B (Form 1099-INT, Form 1099-OID, Form 1099-DIV),
; Form 1099-G unemployment compensation, and the State and Local Income Tax
; Refund Worksheet (26 U.S.C. §§ 61, 85, 103, 111).
(def non-statutory-w2s ((w2s (Slice ret/W2Document))) (Slice ret/W2Document) (keep (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Bool (is (. w 'statutory_employee_business) "")) w2s))

(def w2-box12-code-sum ((w ret/W2Document) (code String)) Money (sum (fn ((ca fed/FormW2.CodedAmount)) Money (if (is (. ca 'code) code) (. ca 'amount) #usd"0.00")) (. w 'form.coded_amounts)))

(def total-w2-wages ((docs ret/Documents)) Money :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "61" "(a)(1)") (doc "us-irs-1040-instructions-2025" "line-1a")) (round-dollar (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (. w 'form.wages_tips_other_compensation)) (non-statutory-w2s (. docs 'w2s)))))

(def total-unreported-or-allocated-tips ((docs ret/Documents)) Money :cite ((doc "us-irs-1040-instructions-2025" "line-1c")) (round-dollar (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (. w 'form.allocated_tips)) (. docs 'w2s))))

(def total-nontaxable-combat-pay ((docs ret/Documents)) Money :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "112") (doc "us-irs-1040-instructions-2025" "line-1i")) (round-dollar (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (w2-box12-code-sum w "Q")) (. docs 'w2s))))

(def w2-employer-hsa-for-person ((docs ret/Documents) (person-id String)) Money :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "223" "(d)") (doc "us-irs-8889-instructions-2025" "line-9")) (round-dollar (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person-id) (if (> (. w 'corrected_employer_hsa_contributions) #usd"0.00") (. w 'corrected_employer_hsa_contributions) (w2-box12-code-sum w "W")) #usd"0.00")) (. docs 'w2s))))

(def w2-wages-for-person ((docs ret/Documents) (person-id String)) Money (round-dollar (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person-id) (. w 'form.wages_tips_other_compensation) #usd"0.00")) (non-statutory-w2s (. docs 'w2s)))))

(def w2-medicare-wages-for-person ((docs ret/Documents) (person-id String)) Money (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person-id) (. w 'form.medicare_wages_and_tips) #usd"0.00")) (. docs 'w2s)))

(def w2-medicare-withheld-total ((docs ret/Documents)) Money (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (. w 'form.medicare_tax_withheld)) (. docs 'w2s)))

(def w2-ss-wages-for-person ((docs ret/Documents) (person-id String)) Money (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person-id) (+ (. w 'form.social_security_wages) (. w 'form.social_security_tips)) #usd"0.00")) (. docs 'w2s)))

(def person-excess-ss-withheld ((docs ret/Documents) (person-id String) (p FederalYear)) Money :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "31" "(b)") (doc "us-irs-1040-instructions-2025" "excess-social-security")) (withs (person-w2s (keep (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Bool (is (. w 'person) person-id)) (. docs 'w2s)) ss-withheld (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (. w 'form.social_security_tax_withheld)) person-w2s)) (if (<= (len person-w2s) 1) #usd"0.00" (round-dollar (clamp-zero (- ss-withheld (. p 'oasdi_max_tax)))))))

(def person-covered-by-workplace-plan? ((docs ret/Documents) (retire ret/Retirement) (person-id String)) Bool :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "219" "(g)(5)")) (withs (w2-covered (some (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Bool (all-of (is (. w 'person) person-id) (. w 'form.retirement_plan))) (. docs 'w2s)) override-covered (some (fn ((pr ret/PersonRetirement)) Bool (all-of (is (. pr 'person) person-id) (. pr 'covered_by_workplace_plan_override))) (. retire 'persons))) (any-of w2-covered override-covered)))

; -- Schedule B: Interest and Ordinary Dividends ------------------------------
(def net-1099-int-taxable ((d ret/Form1099INTDocument)) Money (if (!= (. d 'activity) "") #usd"0.00" (clamp-zero (- (+ (. d 'form.interest_income) (. d 'form.savings_bond_and_treasury_interest)) (+ (. d 'form.bond_premium) (. d 'form.bond_premium_on_treasury_obligations) (. d 'nominee_interest) (. d 'accrued_interest_paid) (. d 'bond_premium_adjustment))))))

(def net-1099-oid-taxable ((d ret/Form1099OIDDocument)) Money (clamp-zero (- (+ (. d 'form.original_issue_discount) (. d 'form.other_periodic_interest) (. d 'form.original_issue_discount_on_treasury_obligations)) (+ (. d 'form.acquisition_premium) (. d 'form.bond_premium) (. d 'oid_adjustment) (. d 'nominee_oid)))))

(def total-tax-exempt-interest ((docs ret/Documents)) Money :cite ((law "26 U.S.C." "103") (doc "us-irs-1040-instructions-2025" "line-2a")) (round-dollar (+ (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099INTDocument)) Money (clamp-zero (- (. d 'form.tax_exempt_interest) (. d 'form.bond_premium_on_tax_exempt_bond)))) (. docs 'interest)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099OIDDocument)) Money (. d 'form.tax_exempt_oid)) (. docs 'original_issue_discount)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099DIVDocument)) Money (. d 'form.exempt_interest_dividends)) (. docs 'dividends)))))

(def net-1099-div-ordinary ((d ret/Form1099DIVDocument)) Money (clamp-zero (- (. d 'form.ordinary_dividends) (. d 'nominee_dividends))))

(def net-1099-div-qualified ((d ret/Form1099DIVDocument)) Money (min (net-1099-div-ordinary d) (clamp-zero (- (. d 'form.qualified_dividends) (. d 'qualified_dividends_not_held_long_enough)))))

; One band of a state rate schedule: taxable income from floor to ceiling is
; taxed at rate_bp basis points. The top band's ceiling is a sentinel far
; above any income.
(defstruct StateBracket (floor Money) (ceiling Money) (rate_bp Int))

; The tax on taxable income through a rate schedule, each band figured on its
; own and rounded to the cent, as the rate schedules print it. A state that
; rounds each band to a whole dollar, as Oregon does, says so.
;
; The rate is held in basis points and applied as (income * bp) / 10000, so
; the arithmetic is exact: a decimal rate such as 0.093 has no exact Float.
(def state-bracket-tax ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money) (whole-dollars Bool)) Money (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable)) (sum (fn ((row StateBracket)) Money (withs (income (clamp-zero (- (min ti (. row 'ceiling)) (. row 'floor))) tax (round-cents (/ (* income (int-to-float (. row 'rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (if whole-dollars (round-dollar tax) tax))) rows)))

; The rate, in basis points, on the next dollar of taxable income.
(def state-marginal-rate-bp ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money)) Int (fold (fn ((acc Int) (row StateBracket)) Int (if (or (> taxable (. row 'floor)) (is (. row 'floor) #usd"0.00")) (. row 'rate_bp) acc)) 0 rows))

; State income tax withheld for one state, from every document that reports
; it: W-2 box 17, and the state boxes of Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV and 1099-R.
(def state-tax-withheld ((docs ret/Documents) (state String)) Money (withs (of-state (fn ((sws (Slice common/StateTaxWithholding))) Money (sum (fn ((sw common/StateTaxWithholding)) Money (if (is (. sw 'state) state) (. sw 'tax_withheld) #usd"0.00")) sws))) (+ (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (of-state (. w 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'w2s)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099INTDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'interest)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099DIVDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'dividends)) (sum (fn ((d ret/Form1099RDocument)) Money (of-state (. d 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'retirement_distributions)))))

; How many of the filer and, on a joint return, the spouse were 65 or older
; at the end of the year, and how many were blind. The federal standard
; deduction worksheet counts the same boxes.
(def state-senior-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus) (tax-year Int)) Int (+ (if (born-before-65-cutoff? (. hh 'taxpayer.date_of_birth) tax-year) 1 0) (if (and (state-joint? status) (born-before-65-cutoff? (. hh 'spouse.date_of_birth) tax-year)) 1 0)))

(def state-blind-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Int (+ (if (. hh 'taxpayer.blind) 1 0) (if (and (state-joint? status) (. hh 'spouse.blind)) 1 0)))

(def state-joint? ((status fed/FilingStatus)) Bool (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY))

(= al-filing-statuses (Table fed/FilingStatus al40/FilingStatus) (table 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE 'al40/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY 'al40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY 'al40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD 'al40/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_FAMILY 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE 'al40/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE))

; Form 40, Alabama Individual Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: wages, interest and
; dividends, the federal filing status, the dependents it claims and the
; federal income tax Alabama lets the filer deduct. Page 2's other income and
; adjustments, itemized deductions, Schedule OC credits and estimated payments
; come from AlabamaInputs.
;
; The rules cite the Code of Alabama, Title 40, Chapter 18. The parts of the
; booklet they implement are named in sources/catalog/al/2025.
; The tax on taxable income: 2% on the first band, 4% on the second, 5% on the
; rest, with joint bands twice as wide. Below the tax table's ceiling the tax
; is figured on the midpoint of the $100 row the income falls in, and rounded
; to the dollar, as the table prints it.
(def al-tax ((y AlabamaYear) (joint Bool) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "Ala. Code" "40-18-5") (doc "al-dor-form-40-booklet-2025" "tax-table")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) scale (if joint 2 1) c1 (* (. y 'band_1_ceiling) scale) c2 (* (. y 'band_2_ceiling) scale) base (if (< ti (. y 'tax_table_ceiling)) (+ (* #usd"100.00" (floor-float (/ ti #usd"100.00"))) #usd"50.00") ti) band1 (min base c1) band2 (clamp-zero (- (min base c2) c1)) band3 (clamp-zero (- base c2))) (if (<= ti #usd"0.00") #usd"0.00" (round-dollar (+ (* band1 0.02) (* band2 0.04) (* band3 0.05))))))

; The standard deduction from the chart: the full amount up to the start of
; the phase-out, then less one step for each band of adjusted gross income,
; to a floor reached after the last step.
(def al-standard-deduction ((y AlabamaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (agi Money)) Money :cite ((law "Ala. Code" "40-18-15") (doc "al-dor-form-40-booklet-2025" "standard-deduction-chart")) (withs (separate (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) hof (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) joint (state-joint? status) full (cond (joint (. y 'standard_joint)) (separate (. y 'standard_separate)) (hof (. y 'standard_head_of_family)) (else (. y 'standard_single))) step (cond (joint (. y 'standard_joint_step)) (separate (. y 'standard_separate_step)) (hof (. y 'standard_head_of_family_step)) (else (. y 'standard_single_step))) start (if separate (. y 'standard_phaseout_start_separate) (. y 'standard_phaseout_start)) width (if separate (. y 'standard_phaseout_width_separate) (. y 'standard_phaseout_width)) steps (if (< agi start) 0.0 (min (int-to-float (. y 'standard_phaseout_steps)) (+ 1.0 (floor-float (/ (- agi start) width)))))) (- full (* step steps))))

; The exemption for each dependent, by adjusted gross income.
(def al-dependent-exemption-each ((y AlabamaYear) (agi Money)) Money :cite ((law "Ala. Code" "40-18-19") (doc "al-dor-form-40-booklet-2025" "dependent-exemption-chart")) (cond ((<= agi (. y 'dependent_low_ceiling)) (. y 'dependent_exemption_low)) ((<= agi (. y 'dependent_mid_ceiling)) (. y 'dependent_exemption_mid)) (else (. y 'dependent_exemption_high))))

; The Federal Income Tax Deduction Worksheet: federal tax after nonrefundable
; credits less the refundable credits it names, not below zero. The net
; investment income tax on its line 2 is not modelled.
(def al-federal-tax-deduction ((fed-ret ret/FederalReturn)) Money :cite ((law "Ala. Code" "40-18-15") (doc "al-dor-form-40-booklet-2025" "federal-tax-deduction-worksheet")) (withs (f (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040)) (clamp-zero (- (. f 'tax_after_credits) (+ (. f 'earned_income_credit) (. f 'additional_child_tax_credit) (. f 'american_opportunity_credit) (. f 'refundable_adoption_credit))))))

Code" "40-18-5")) (bind hh (. inputs 'federal.household)) (bind docs (. inputs 'federal.documents)) (bind status (. fed-ret 'summary.filing_status)) (bind joint (state-joint? status)) (bind dependents (state-dependent-count hh tax-year)) (bind f1040 (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040)) (set :tax_year tax-year) (set :filing_status (lookup-or al-filing-statuses status 'al40/FILING_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED)) (set :dependents dependents) (part "Income and Adjustments" (line "5a" "Alabama income tax withheld" (state-tax-withheld docs "AL") :field alabama_tax_withheld) (line "5b" "Wages, salaries, tips" (. f1040 'total_wages) :field wages) (line 6 "Interest and dividend income" (+ (. f1040 'taxable_interest) (. f1040 'ordinary_dividends)) :field interest_and_dividends) (line 7 "Other income from page 2, Part I" (. al-in 'other_income) :field other_income) (line 8 "Total income: lines 5b through 7" (+ line5b line6 line7) :field total_income) (line 9 "Total adjustments from page 2, Part II" (. al-in 'adjustments) :field total_adjustments) (line 10 "Adjusted gross income: line 8 minus line 9" (- line8 line9) :field adjusted_gross_income)) (part "Deductions" (bind standard (al-standard-deduction y status line10)) (bind itemized (. al-in 'itemized_deductions)) (bind itemizes (state-uses-itemized? (. al-in 'deduction_method) standard itemized)) (set :itemizes itemizes) (line 11 "Itemized or standard deduction" (if itemizes itemized standard) :field deduction) (line 12 "Federal tax deduction" (al-federal-tax-deduction fed-ret) :field federal_tax_deduction) (line 13 "Personal exemption" (if (or joint (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD)) (. y 'personal_exemption_joint) (. y 'personal_exemption_single)) :field personal_exemption) (line 14 "Dependent exemption from page 2, Part III" (* (al-dependent-exemption-each y line10) dependents) :field dependent_exemption) (line 15 "Total deductions: lines 11 through 14" (+ line11 line12 line13 line14) :field total_deductions) (line 16 "Taxable income: line 10 minus line 15" (clamp-zero (- line10 line15)) :field taxable_income)) (part "Tax" (line 17 "Income tax from the tax table" (al-tax y joint line16) :field income_tax) (line 18 "Net tax due Alabama: line 17 less Schedule OC credits" (clamp-zero (- line17 (. al-in 'nonrefundable_credits))) :field net_tax) (line 19 "Additional taxes from Schedule ATP" #usd"0.00" :field additional_taxes) (line "20a" "Alabama Democratic Party contribution" #usd"0.00" :field democratic_party_contribution) (line "20b" "Alabama Republican Party contribution" #usd"0.00" :field republican_party_contribution) (line 21 "Total tax liability: lines 18, 19, 20a and 20b" (+ line18 Code 40-18-2"))) (withs (y (al-year tax-year) status (. fed-ret 'summary.filing_status) form (al-form-40 y inputs al-in fed-ret tax-year) agi (. form 'adjusted_gross_income) tax (. form 'total_tax_liability) diagnostics ((inst empty-slice ret/Diagnostic))) (proto 'ret/AlabamaReturn :status (state-return-status diagnostics) :summary (proto 'ret/Summary :jurisdiction "AL" :filing_status status :total_income (. form 'total_income) :adjusted_gross_income agi :total_deductions (. form 'total_deductions) :taxable_income (. form 'taxable_income) :total_tax tax :total_payments_and_refundable_credits (. form 'adjusted_total_payments) :refund (. form 'refund) :amount_owed (. form 'amount_owed) :effective_tax_rate (state-effective-rate tax agi) :marginal_ordinary_rate 0.05) :diagnostics diagnostics :forms (proto 'facts/AlabamaReturn :form_40 form)))))

; Form AR1000F, Arkansas Individual Income Tax Return for full-year
; residents.
;
; Arkansas does not start from federal adjusted gross income: it lists each
; kind of income as Arkansas counts it, taken here from the prepared federal
; return. Social security, military pay and military retirement are left out,
; and the first $6,000 of pension and IRA income is excluded.
;
; Only column A is modelled, so filing status 4 (married filing separately on
; the same return) is not. The rules take the standard deduction and the
; regular tax table; the low income tables and itemized deductions are not
; modelled.

; The rules cite the law (Ark. Code Ann. title 26, chapter 51). The parts of
; the form and instructions they implement name them in
; sources/catalog/ar/2025.
; The tax from the 2025 Regular Income Tax Table on net taxable income: the
; row whose floor is the largest not above the income, and above the table
; $3,809 plus 3.9% of the excess over $100,000.
(def ar-table-tax ((y ArkansasYear) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "Ark. Code Ann." "26-51-201")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero income)) (if (> ti (. y 'table_ceiling)) (+ (. y 'table_ceiling_tax) (round-dollar (/ (* (- ti (. y 'table_ceiling)) (int-to-float (. y 'top_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (fold (fn ((acc Money) (row ArkansasTaxRow)) Money (if (<= (. row 'floor) ti) (. row 'tax) acc)) #usd"0.00" ar-regular-table-2025))))

;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the federal
; filing status and deduction method, and the federal credits the District
; follows. District-only figures (Schedule I's other additions and
; subtractions, Schedule U's credits, the Schedule H property tax credit, the

; responsibility payment and estimated payments) are taken as inputs.

; and booklet they implement name them in sources/catalog/dc/2025.
; Line 18, the standard deduction: the District's basic amount for the filing
; status and the additional amount for each filer 65 or older or blind.
(defworksheet dc-standard-deduction ((y DistrictOfColumbiaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (additions Int)) Money :cite ((law "D.C. Code" "47-1801.04")) (line "a" "Basic standard deduction for the filing status" (cond ((or (state-joint? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_head_of_household)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single)))) (line "f" "Number of additions for age 65 or older and blindness" additions) (line "g" "Additional standard deduction: $2,000 each if single or head of household, $1,600 otherwise" (* (if (or (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD)) (. y 'additional_standard_deduction_unmarried) (. y 'additional_standard_deduction_married)) (int-to-float linef))) (line "h" "Standard deduction: add lines a and g" (+ linea lineg)) (result lineh))

; Line 18, itemized deductions: Calculation F, letter by letter. The federal
; itemized deductions less every state and local tax deducted (Schedule A line
; 7), with real estate tax (line 5b) and other taxes (line 6) added back in
; full; above $200,000 of DC AGI ($100,000 filing separately), less 5% of the
; excess, which never reduces medical expenses, investment interest or
; casualty losses (Schedule A lines 4, 9 and 15).
(defworksheet dc-itemized-deduction ((y DistrictOfColumbiaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (fed-ret ret/FederalReturn) (dc-agi Money)) Money :cite ((law "D.C. Code" "47-1803.04")) (bind a (. fed-ret 'forms.schedule_a)) (line "a" "Total itemized deductions from Schedule A, Line 17" (. a 'total_itemized_deductions)) (line "b" "Total state and local tax deductions, Schedule A, Line 7" (. a 'total_taxes_paid)) (line "c" "Subtract Line b from Line a" (- linea lineb)) (line "d" "State and local real estate tax, Schedule A, Line 5b" (. a 'state_local_real_estate_taxes)) (line "e" "Other taxes, Schedule A, Line 6" (. a 'other_taxes)) (line "f" "DC itemized deductions: add Lines c, d and e" (+ linec lined linee)) (line "g" "Schedule A, Lines 4, 9 and 15" (+ (. a 'deductible_medical_and_dental) (. a 'investment_interest) (. a 'casualty_and_theft_losses))) (line "h" "Subtract Line g from Line f" (- linef lineg)) (line "i" "DC adjusted gross income" dc-agi) (line "j" "$200,000 ($100,000 if married filing separately)" (if (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'itemized_limit_threshold_separate) (. y 'itemized_limit_threshold))) (line "k" "Subtract Line j from Line i" (clamp-zero (- linei linej))) (line "l" "Multiply Line k by 5%" (round-dollar (/ (* linek (int-to-float (. y 'itemized_limit_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (line "m" "Subtract Line l from Line h, not less than zero" (clamp-zero (- lineh linel))) (line "n" "Add Lines g and m" (+ lineg linem)) (result (if (> linei linej) linen linef)))

; Line 20, the tax. Up to $100,000 of taxable income the tax tables give it:
; each $50 row is taxed at its midpoint through the rate schedule and rounded
; to the dollar. In the 8.5% band, from $60,000, the printed table runs one
; dollar below that figure on every row (60,000-60,049 is $3,501, 99,950-99,999
; is $6,897), and the filer must use the table, so the rule does too. Above
; $100,000, Calculation I applies the schedule to the taxable income itself.
(def dc-tax ((y DistrictOfColumbiaYear) (rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "D.C. ; IT-511 booklet and Form 500 they implement name them in

; Wages on the W-2s of one person.
(def ga-person-wages ((docs ret/Documents) (person String)) Money :cite ((law "O.C.G.A." "48-7-27")) (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person) (. w 'form.wages_tips_other_compensation) #usd"0.00")) (. docs 'w2s)))

; The income Schedule 1 page 2 counts as retirement income other than earned
; income, lines 6 to 13: interest, dividends, capital gains, taxable IRA
; distributions and taxable pensions, as the federal return reports them.
(def ga-unearned-retirement-income ((fed-ret ret/FederalReturn)) Money :cite ((law "O.C.G.A." "48-7-27")) (withs (f (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040)) (+ (. f 'taxable_interest) (. f 'ordinary_dividends) (. f 'capital_gain_or_loss) (. f 'ira_distributions_taxable) (. f 'pensions_and_annuities_taxable))))

; The largest exclusion for a person of this age at the end of the year:
; $65,000 at 65 or older, $35,000 at 62 to 64, and nothing younger. The
; exclusion for a permanently disabled person under 62 is not modelled.
(def ga-retirement-exclusion-limit ((y GeorgiaYear) (age Int)) Money :cite ((law "O.C.G.A." "48-7-27")) (cond ((>= age 65) (. y 'retirement_exclusion_65_and_over)) ((>= age 62) (. y 'retirement_exclusion_62_to_64)) (else #usd"0.00")))

"48-7-27")) (line 3 "Total earned income" wages) (line 4 "Maximum earned income" (. y 'retirement_earned_income_cap)) (line 5 "The lesser of line 3 or 4; if zero or less, enter zero" (clamp-zero (min line3 line4))) (line 14 "Total of lines 6 through 13; if zero or less, enter zero" (clamp-zero unearned)) (line 15 "Add lines 5 and 14" (+ line5 line14)) (line 16 "Maximum allowable exclusion" (ga-retirement-exclusion-limit y age)) (line 17 "The lesser of lines 15 and 16" (min line15 line16)) (result line17))

; Form N-11, Hawaii Individual Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status, the dependents the federal return claims, and
; Hawaii-specific additions, subtractions and credits. Hawaii's credits are
; entered as their own forms and schedules figure them; they are not worked
; out here.
;
; The rules cite the law (HRS chapter 235). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/hi/2025.
; The rate schedule for a filing status: Schedule I for single and separate
; filers, II for joint filers and surviving spouses, III for heads of household.
(def hi-rate-schedule ((status fed/FilingStatus)) (Slice HawaiiRateRow) :cite ((law "HRS" "235-51")) (cond ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) hi-schedule-ii-2025) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) hi-schedule-ii-2025) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) hi-schedule-iii-2025) (else hi-schedule-i-2025)))

; The tax a rate schedule sets on an income: the base of the highest row the
; income is over, plus that row's rate on the excess, to the nearest dollar.
(def hi-schedule-tax ((rows (Slice HawaiiRateRow)) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "HRS" "235-51")) (round-dollar (fold (fn ((acc Money) (row HawaiiRateRow)) Money (if (> income (. row 'floor)) (+ (. row 'base) (/ (* (- income (. row 'floor)) (int-to-float (. row 'rate_bp))) 10000.0)) acc)) #usd"0.00" rows)))

; The rate, in basis points, on the next dollar of taxable income.
(def hi-marginal-rate-bp ((rows (Slice HawaiiRateRow)) (income Money)) Int :cite ((law "HRS" "235-51")) (fold (fn ((acc Int) (row HawaiiRateRow)) Int (if (or (> income (. row 'floor)) (is (. row 'floor) #usd"0.00")) (. row 'rate_bp) acc)) 0 rows))

; Form N-11 line 27: the tax on taxable income. Below $100,000 it comes from
; the tax table, whose rows are $50 wide and whose tax is the schedule's tax
; at each row's midpoint; from $100,000 the rate schedules apply directly.
(def hi-tax ((y HawaiiYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "HRS" "235-51") (doc "hi-dotax-form-n-11-instructions-2025" "tax-table")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) rows (hi-rate-schedule status) width (. y 'tax_table_row_width)) (if (< ti (. y 'tax_table_ceiling)) (withs (steps (floor-float (/ ti width)) midpoint (+ (* width steps) (/ width 2.0))) (hi-schedule-tax rows midpoint)) (hi-schedule-tax rows ti))))

; Form N-11 line 23: the standard deduction for the filing status.
(def hi-standard-deduction ((y HawaiiYear) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Money :cite ((law "HRS" "235-2.4")) (cond ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_head_of_household)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single))))

; Form N-11 line 6e: the exemptions claimed. The filer, unless someone else
; can claim them; the spouse on a joint return; one more for each of them 65
; or over; and each dependent.
(def hi-exemption-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus) (tax-year Int)) Int :cite ((law "HRS" "235-54")) (+ (if (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent) 0 1) (if (state-joint? status) 1 0) (if (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent) 0 (state-senior-count hh status tax-year)) (state-dependent-count hh tax-year)))

"HRS 235-51(f)")) ((inst empty-slice ret/Diagnostic)))))

;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal taxable income,
; the federal filing status and the dependents it claims. IA 1040 Schedule 1
; turns federal taxable income into Iowa taxable income; only its Social
; Security, retirement income and other lines are figured here, and they reach
; the form as their net on line 3.
;
; The rules cite the law (Iowa Code chapter 422). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/ia/2025.
; The age from which Iowa excludes retirement income, IA 1040 Schedule 1
; line 7.

(def ia-claimable? ((hh ret/Household)) Bool :cite ((law "Iowa Code" "422.5")) (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent))

; IA 1040 Schedule 1, line 7: IRA, pension and annuity income in federal
; income that Iowa excludes. Every filer on the return must be 55 or older:
; a joint return where only one spouse is cannot be split from the federal
; return, so nothing is excluded and a diagnostic says so.
(def ia-retirement-exclusion ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus) (fed-ret ret/FederalReturn) (tax-year Int)) Money :cite ((law "Iowa Code" "422.7")) (withs (filers (if (state-joint? status) 2 1) eligible (ia-retirement-age-count hh status tax-year)) (if (is eligible filers) (+ (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040.ira_distributions_taxable) (. fed-ret 'forms.form_1040.pensions_and_annuities_taxable)) #usd"0.00")))

; subtractions; Social Security benefits (line 5) and retirement income
; (line 7) come from the federal return, the rest from the Iowa inputs.

; Form 40, Idaho Individual Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status, the federal deductions, and the dependents the
; federal return claims.
;
; The rules cite Idaho Code Title 63, Chapter 30. The parts of the form and
; its instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/id/2025.
; Whether the filer is someone else's dependent, line 12c.
(def id-claimable? ((hh ret/Household)) Bool :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (any-of (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent)))

; Whether a status takes the joint standard deduction and filing requirement.
(def id-joint-figures? ((status fed/FilingStatus)) Bool :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (or (state-joint? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)))

; The addition to the standard deduction for each box checked on lines 12a
; and 12b: one amount if single or head of household, another if married.
(def id-additional-amount ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (if (or (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD)) (. y 'additional_unmarried) (. y 'additional_married)))

; The standard deduction for a filing status before any addition.
(def id-basic-standard-deduction ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (cond ((id-joint-figures? status) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_hoh)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single))))

; Form 40 line 16: the Standard Deduction Worksheet.
(defworksheet id-standard-deduction ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (claimable Bool) (earned Money) (boxes Int)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (line 1 "Standard deduction for your filing status" (id-basic-standard-deduction y status)) (line 3 "Earned income plus $450, or $1,350 if more" (max (. y 'dependent_minimum) (+ earned (. y 'dependent_addition)))) (line 4 "The smaller of lines 1 and 3 for a dependent, otherwise line 1" (if claimable (min line1 line3) line1)) (line 5 "Boxes checked on lines 12a and 12b times $1,600, or $2,000 if single or head of household" (* (id-additional-amount y status) (int-to-float boxes))) (line 6 "Standard deduction: add lines 4 and 5" (+ line4 line5)) (result line6))

; Form 40 line 14: the state and local income or sales taxes in the federal
; itemized deductions. Up to the threshold on Schedule A line 5d it is line
; 5a; above it, line 5e less the property taxes on lines 5b and 5c.
(def id-itemized-income-taxes ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (fed-ret ret/FederalReturn)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3022")) (withs (a (. fed-ret 'forms.schedule_a) limit (if (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'salt_threshold_separate) (. y 'salt_threshold))) (if (<= (. a 'total_state_and_local_taxes) limit) (. a 'state_local_income_or_sales_taxes) (clamp-zero (- (. a 'state_and_local_taxes_after_cap) (+ (. a 'state_local_real_estate_taxes) (. a 'state_local_personal_property_taxes)))))))

; Form 40 line 20: the tax worksheet. Taxable income above the zero-rate
; amount is taxed at 5.3%, in whole dollars.
(defworksheet id-tax ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3024")) (line 1 "Idaho taxable income from Form 40, line 19" taxable) (line 2 "Zero-rate amount for your filing status" (if (or (id-joint-figures? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD)) (. y 'zero_rate_joint) (. y 'zero_rate_single))) (line 3 "Subtract line 2 from line 1" (- line1 line2)) (line 4 "Multiply the subtotal by 5.3%" (round-dollar (/ (* line3 (int-to-float (. y 'rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (line 5 "Idaho tax, not less than zero" (clamp-zero line4)) (result line5))

; Form 40 line 24: the Child Tax Credit Worksheet. $205 for each qualifying
; child, no more than the tax left after lines 21 to 23.
(defworksheet id-child-tax-credit ((y IdahoYear) (children Int) (tax Money) (other-credits Money)) Money :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3029L")) (line 1 "Number of qualifying children" children) (line 2 "Multiply line 1 by $205" (* (. y 'child_credit) (int-to-float line1))) (line 7 "Line 20 less lines 21 through 23, not less than zero" (clamp-zero (- tax other-credits))) (line 8 "The lesser of lines 2 and 7" (min line2 line7)) (result line8))

; Whether Idaho requires the return, which decides the permanent building
; fund tax: gross income at or above the standard deduction for the status,
; plus the addition for each spouse 65 or older; $5 if married filing
; separately. Federal total income stands in for gross income.
(def id-required-to-file? ((y IdahoYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (gross Money) (seniors Int)) Bool :cite ((law "Idaho Code" "63-3030")) (if (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (>= gross (. y 'filing_threshold_separate)) (>= gross (+ (id-basic-standard-deduction y status) (* (id-additional-amount y status) (int-to-float seniors))))))

(def ks-joint? ((status ksk40/FilingStatus)) Bool :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,110")) (is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY))

; Whether the Kansas status is married, jointly or separately.
(def ks-married? ((status ksk40/FilingStatus)) Bool :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,119")) (or (is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) (is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY)))

; The tax on an amount of taxable income at the two rates of K.S.A.
; 79-32,110(a), before rounding.
(def ks-rate-tax ((y KansasYear) (status ksk40/FilingStatus) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,110")) (withs (bracket (if (ks-joint? status) (. y 'bracket_joint) (. y 'bracket_single)) lower (min income bracket) upper (clamp-zero (- income bracket))) (+ (/ (* lower (int-to-float (. y 'lower_rate_bp))) 10000.0) (/ (* upper (int-to-float (. y 'upper_rate_bp))) 10000.0))))

; Line 8, Tax. Taxable income of $100,000 or less is looked up in the Tax
; Tables, whose rows are $50 wide (the first two are $25) and whose tax is
; the tax on the row's midpoint, rounded to the dollar. Above $100,000 the
; Tax Computation Worksheet multiplies line 7 by 5.58% and subtracts the
; rounded amount it prints.
(defworksheet ks-tax ((y KansasYear) (status ksk40/FilingStatus) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,110")) (bind joint (ks-joint? status)) (line "a" "Taxable income from line 7" (clamp-zero taxable)) (line "b" "Tax from the Tax Tables or the Tax Computation Worksheet" (cond ((<= linea #usd"0.00") #usd"0.00") ((<= linea (. y 'tax_table_ceiling)) (withs (midpoint (cond ((<= linea #usd"25.00") #usd"12.50") ((<= linea #usd"50.00") #usd"38.00") (else (- (* (. y 'tax_table_step) (ceil-float (/ linea (. y 'tax_table_step)))) #usd"24.50")))) (round-dollar (ks-rate-tax y status midpoint)))) (else (round-dollar (- (/ (* linea (int-to-float (. y 'upper_rate_bp))) 10000.0) (if joint (. y 'worksheet_subtraction_joint) (. y 'worksheet_subtraction_single))))))) (result lineb))

; Line 4, the Kansas standard deduction, with the worksheet for people 65 or
; older or blind.
(defworksheet ks-standard-deduction ((y KansasYear) (status ksk40/FilingStatus) (boxes Int)) Money :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,119")) (line 1 "Standard deduction for the filing status" (cond ((is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_head_of_household)) ((is status 'ksk40/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'standard_deduction_separate)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single)))) (line 2 "Added for each box checked for 65 or older or blind" (* boxes (if (ks-married? status) (. y 'additional_standard_married) (. y 'additional_standard_single)))) (line 3 "Standard deduction: add lines 1 and 2" (+ line1 line2)) (result line3))

; Line 17 and line 22, the Kansas earned income tax credit worksheet.
(defworksheet ks-earned-income-credit ((y KansasYear) (fed-eitc Money)) Money :cite ((law "K.S.A." "79-32,205")) (line 1 "Federal EITC from the federal return" (clamp-zero fed-eitc)) (line 2 "Kansas EITC: line 1 multiplied by 17%" (round-dollar (/ (* line1 (int-to-float (. y 'eitc_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (result line2))

"79-32,110")) (if (not (ks-has-year? tax-year)) (proto 'ret/KansasReturn :status 'ret/RETURN_STATUS_INCOMPLETE :diagnostics (slice (state-diagnostic "KS_NO_RULES_FOR_YEAR" 'ret/SEVERITY_ERROR "No Kansas rules are built for this tax year." ; Look up Kentucky published figures for the given tax year.
(def ky-year ((tax-year Int)) KentuckyYear :cite ((law "KRS" "141.020") (law "KRS" "141.081")) ky-year-2025)

; Whether Kentucky rules are built for the given tax year.
(def ky-has-year? ((tax-year Int)) Bool :cite ((law "KRS" "141.020")) (is tax-year 2025))

; Kentucky has no head of household or surviving spouse status: those filers
; file as single. A federal joint return files jointly; a federal separate
; return files separate returns.
(= ky-filing-statuses (Table fed/FilingStatus ky740/FilingStatus) (table 'fed/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE 'ky740/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY 'ky740/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY 'ky740/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD 'ky740/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE 'ky740/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE))

; Form 740, Kentucky Individual Income Tax Return for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status, the dependents the federal return claims, and
; Kentucky-specific additions, subtractions and payments.
;
; Page 1 has two columns. Column A is the spouse's on a combined return
; (filing status 2); these rules file every return in Column B alone, as a
; single, joint or separate return, so line 19 equals Column B's line 18.
;
; The rules cite the law (KRS Chapter 141). The parts of the form and Schedule
; ITC they implement name them in sources/catalog/ky/2025.
; Schedule ITC, Section B: personal tax credits for the filer and, on a joint
; return, the spouse, assigned to Column B and capped.
(defworksheet ky-personal-tax-credits ((y KentuckyYear) (joint Bool) (senior-count Int) (blind-count Int) (guard-count Int)) Money :cite ((law "KRS" "141.020" "(3)")) (line 1 "65 or older: $40 each" (* senior-count (. y 'senior_credit))) (line 2 "Legally blind: $40 each" (* blind-count (. y 'blind_credit))) (line 3 "Kentucky National Guard: $20 each" (* guard-count (. y 'national_guard_credit))) (line 4 "Allowable credit, not more than $100, or $200 on a joint return" (min (+ line1 line2 line3) (if joint (. y 'personal_credit_cap_joint) (. y 'personal_credit_cap_single)))) (result line4))

; Schedule ITC, Section C: the family size is the filer, a spouse on a joint
; return, and each qualifying child under 19, four at most.
(def ky-family-size ((hh ret/Household) (joint Bool) (tax-year Int)) Int :cite ((law "KRS" "141.066")) (min 4 (+ 1 (if joint 1 0) (state-young-children-count hh 18 tax-year))))

; Schedule ITC, worksheet for modified gross income: the greater of federal
; AGI with non-Kentucky municipal bond interest added, and Kentucky AGI.
(defworksheet ky-modified-gross-income ((fed-agi Money) (municipal-interest Money) (ky-agi Money)) Money :cite ((law "KRS" "141.066")) (line "a" "Federal adjusted gross income, not below zero" (clamp-zero fed-agi)) (line "c" "Tax-exempt interest from non-Kentucky municipal bonds" (clamp-zero municipal-interest)) (line "e" "Total of lines (a) and (c)" (+ linea linec)) (line "f" "Kentucky adjusted gross income, not below zero" (clamp-zero ky-agi)) (line "j" "Modified gross income: the greater of line (e) and line (f)" (max linee linef)) (result linej))

; Schedule ITC, Section C table: the credit percentage for a family size and
; modified gross income.
(def ky-family-size-credit-percent ((y KentuckyYear) (size Int) (mgi Money)) Int :cite ((law "KRS" "141.066")) (withs (rows (cond ((<= size 1) (. y 'family_size_1)) ((is size 2) (. y 'family_size_2)) ((is size 3) (. y 'family_size_3)) (else (. y 'family_size_4)))) (fold (fn ((acc Int) (b FamilySizeBracket)) Int (if (is acc -1) (if (<= mgi (. b 'up_to)) (. b 'percent) -1) acc)) -1 rows)))

; dependent child and files as head of household.

; Form 1, Massachusetts Resident Income Tax Return.
;
; Massachusetts does not start from federal adjusted gross income. The return
; sorts income into classes: 5.0% income (wages, pensions, business and rental
; income) on lines 3 to 19, interest and dividends from Schedule B on line 20,
; short-term and collectibles gains at 8.5% and 12% on line 23, and long-term
; gains from Schedule D on line 24. The rules take each class from the prepared
; federal return where it carries it, and from MassachusettsInputs where it
; does not.
;
; Not modelled: Schedules B, D, X, Y and HC in detail (their results are
; inputs or come straight from the federal return), excess exemptions carried
; to Schedules B and D when line 18 exceeds line 17, No Tax Status and the
; Limited Income Credit worksheets, the optional 5.85% rate, and Schedule OJC.
;
; The rules cite the law (M.G.L. c. 62). The parts of the year's form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/ma/2025.
; Form 1 line 2a: the personal exemption for the filing status.
(def ma-personal-exemption ((y MassachusettsYear) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Money :cite ((law "M.G.L. c. 62" "3")) (cond ((state-joint? status) (. y 'personal_exemption_joint)) ((or (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)) (. y 'personal_exemption_hoh)) (else (. y 'personal_exemption_single))))

; Form 1 line 11: Social Security, Medicare and retirement contributions one
; person paid, from W-2 boxes 4 and 6, at most the cap.
(def ma-retirement-contributions ((y MassachusettsYear) (docs ret/Documents) (person-id String)) Money :cite ((law "M.G.L. c. 62" "3")) (min (. y 'retirement_contribution_cap) (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (if (is (. w 'person) person-id) (+ (. w 'form.social_security_tax_withheld) (. w 'form.medicare_tax_withheld)) #usd"0.00")) (. docs 'w2s))))

; Massachusetts tax withheld on the W-2s alone (Form 1 line 38a).
(def ma-w2-withheld ((docs ret/Documents)) Money :cite ((law "M.G.L. c. 62B" "2")) (sum (fn ((w ret/W2Document)) Money (sum (fn ((sw common/StateTaxWithholding)) Money (if (is (. sw 'state) "MA") (. sw 'tax_withheld) #usd"0.00")) (. w 'form.state_tax_withholding))) (. docs 'w2s)))

; Form 1 line 22: the tax on taxable 5.0% income. At or below the table limit
; it is read from the tax table, which taxes the middle of each $50 band at
; 5.0% and rounds to the dollar; income under $10 owes nothing. Above the
; limit it is line 21 times 5.0%.
(def ma-tax-on-taxable-income ((y MassachusettsYear) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "M.G.L. c. 62" "4")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) rate (int-to-float (. y 'rate_bp))) (cond ((< ti #usd"10.00") #usd"0.00") ((<= ti #usd"50.00") #usd"1.00") ((<= ti (. y 'tax_table_limit)) (withs (steps (floor-float (/ (- ti #usd"0.01") #usd"50.00")) band-floor (* #usd"50.00" steps) midpoint (+ band-floor #usd"25.00")) (round-dollar (/ (* midpoint rate) 10000.0)))) (else (round-dollar (/ (* ti rate) 10000.0))))))

; An amount times a rate in basis points, rounded to the dollar.
(def ma-at-rate ((amount Money) (rate-bp Int)) Money :cite ((law "M.G.L. c. 62" "4")) (round-dollar (/ (* (clamp-zero amount) (int-to-float rate-bp)) 10000.0)))

; Schedule 4% Surtax: 4% of taxable income over the threshold. Taxable income

"10-211")) (withs (threshold (if (md-joint-schedule? status) (. y 'exemption_threshold_joint) (. y 'exemption_threshold_single)) step (. y 'exemption_step) full (. y 'exemption)) (cond ((<= fed-agi threshold) full) ((<= fed-agi (+ threshold step)) (/ full 2.0)) ((<= fed-agi (+ threshold (* step 2.0))) (/ full 4.0)) (else #usd"0.00"))))

(def mi-claimable? ((hh ret/Household)) Bool :cite ((law "MCL" "206.30")) (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent))

; Form M1, Minnesota Individual Income Tax, for a full-year resident.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the federal
; filing status and the dependents it claims. The schedules that feed it are
; taken as inputs: Schedule M1M's additions and subtractions, Schedule M1SA's
; itemized deductions, Schedule M1C's nonrefundable credits, and the
; refundable credits of Schedule M1REF, among them the Child and Working
; Family Credits of Schedule M1CWFC.
;
; The rules cite the law (Minn. Stat. ch. 290). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/mn/2025.
; The standard deduction before the income limitation: the Standard Deduction
; Table for Line 4, or for a filer someone else can claim, the Worksheet for
; Line 4 — Dependent Standard Deduction.
(defworksheet mn-basic-standard-deduction ((y MinnesotaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (boxes Int) (claimable Bool) (earned-income Money)) Money :cite ((law "Minn. Stat." "290.0123")) (bind married (or (state-joint? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE))) (line 1 "Basic standard deduction for the filing status" (cond ((or (state-joint? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_hoh)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single)))) (line 2 "Additional amount for each box checked for age 65 or older and blind" (* boxes (if married (. y 'standard_deduction_additional_married) (. y 'standard_deduction_additional_unmarried)))) (line 3 "Standard deduction from the table" (+ line1 line2)) (line 4 "Dependent standard deduction: the greater of $1,250 and earned income plus $350, but no more than line 3" (min line3 (max #usd"1250.00" (+ (clamp-zero earned-income) #usd"350.00")))) (result (if claimable line4 line3)))

; Worksheets A and B for Line 4 — Standard Deduction Limitation.
(defworksheet mn-standard-deduction ((y MinnesotaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (agi Money) (basic Money)) Money :cite ((law "Minn. Stat." "290.0123")) (bind separate (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY)) (bind lower (if separate (/ (. y 'deduction_limit_threshold) 2.0) (. y 'deduction_limit_threshold))) (bind upper (if separate (/ (. y 'deduction_limit_upper_threshold) 2.0) (. y 'deduction_limit_upper_threshold))) (line 1 "Adjusted gross income from line 1 of Form M1" agi) (line 2 "Income over the first threshold, up to the second" (clamp-zero (- (min line1 upper) lower))) (line 3 "Multiply step 2 by 3%" (round-dollar (/ (* line2 (int-to-float (. y 'deduction_limit_low_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (line 4 "Income over the second threshold" (clamp-zero (- line1 upper))) (line 5 "Multiply step 4 by 10%" (round-dollar (/ (* line4 (int-to-float (. y 'deduction_limit_high_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (line 6 "Add steps 3 and 5" (+ line3 line5)) (line 7 "Standard deduction before the limitation" basic) (line 8 "Multiply step 7 by 80%" (round-dollar (/ (* line7 (int-to-float (. y 'deduction_limit_max_bp))) 10000.0))) (line 9 "The lesser of step 6 and step 8" (min line6 line8)) (line 10 "Standard deduction: step 7 minus step 9" (- line7 line9)) (result line10))

; Worksheet for Line 5 — Dependent Exemptions.
(defworksheet mn-dependent-exemptions ((y MinnesotaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (agi Money) (dependents Int) (claimable Bool)) Money :cite ((law "Minn. Stat." "290.0121")) (bind separate (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY)) (bind range (if separate (/ (. y 'exemption_phaseout_range) 2.0) (. y 'exemption_phaseout_range))) (bind step (if separate (/ (. y 'exemption_phaseout_step) 2.0) (. y 'exemption_phaseout_step))) (line 3 "Number of dependents multiplied by $5,200" (* dependents (. y 'dependent_exemption))) (line 4 "Adjusted gross income from line 1 of Form M1" agi) (line 5 "Threshold for the filing status" (cond ((or (state-joint? status) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)) (. y 'exemption_threshold_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'exemption_threshold_hoh)) (separate (. y 'exemption_threshold_separate)) (else (. y 'exemption_threshold_single)))) (line 6 "Income over the threshold" (clamp-zero (- line4 line5))) (bind steps (ceil-float (/ (money-to-float line6) (money-to-float step)))) (line 9 "Reduction: 2% of step 3 for each step of income over the threshold" (round-dollar (/ (* line3 (* steps (int-to-float (. y 'exemption_phaseout_step_rate_bp)))) 10000.0))) (line 10 "Dependent exemptions: step 3 minus step 9" (cond (claimable #usd"0.00") ((> line6 range) #usd"0.00") (else (clamp-zero (- line3 line9))))) (result line10))

; Line 10: the tax from the tax table below $86,800 of taxable income, which
; taxes the middle of each $100 band (the first two bands are $0 to $20, taxed
; nothing, and $20 to $100, taxed as $60), or from the rate schedules above it.
(def mn-tax ((y MinnesotaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "Minn. Stat." "290.06")) (withs (rows (mn-schedule status) ti (clamp-zero taxable) figured (cond ((>= ti (. y 'tax_table_limit)) ti) ((< ti #usd"20.00") #usd"0.00") ((< ti #usd"100.00") #usd"60.00") (else (+ (float-to-money (* (floor-float (/ (money-to-float ti) 100.0)) 100.0)) #usd"50.00")))) (round-dollar (state-bracket-tax rows figured false))))

; Form 80-105, Mississippi Resident Individual Income Tax Return, for
; full-year residents.
;
; Mississippi rebuilds income on page 2 from the federal lines, takes off a
; standard or itemized deduction and a fixed exemption, and taxes taxable
; income above $10,000 at 4.4%.
;
; A married couple may file a joint return, with everything in column A, or a
; combined return, with each spouse's income in their own column. The rules
; prepare the joint return: everything is in column A, and the spouse's
; column is left empty. A diagnostic says when a combined return could cost
; less.
;
; The rules cite the law (Miss. Code Ann. Title 27, Chapter 7). The parts of
; the form and instructions they implement name them in
; sources/catalog/ms/2025.

"27-7-21")) (cond ((is status 'ms80105/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE) (. y 'exemption_single)) ((is status 'ms80105/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_FAMILY) (. y 'exemption_head_of_family)) (else (. y 'exemption_joint))))

; separate return takes half the joint amount.

"27-7-17")) (cond ((is status 'ms80105/FILING_STATUS_SINGLE) (. y 'standard_deduction_single)) ((is status 'ms80105/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'standard_deduction_single)) ((is status 'ms80105/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_FAMILY) (. y 'standard_deduction_head_of_family)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_joint))))

; Montana Form 2, Montana Individual Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal adjusted gross
; income, the federal deductions other than the qualified business income
; deduction, the filing status and the net long-term capital gain. Montana
; adjustments from Schedule I come in as totals.
;
; The rules cite the law (MCA Title 15, Chapter 30). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/mt/2025.
; The top of the lower bracket for the filing status: 4.7% on ordinary income
; and 3% on net long-term capital gains below it.
(def mt-bracket-top ((y MontanaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Money :cite ((law "MCA" "15-30-2103") (doc "mt-dor-form-2-instructions-2025" "tax-rates")) (cond ((state-joint? status) (. y 'bracket_top_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) (. y 'bracket_top_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'bracket_top_head_of_household)) (else (. y 'bracket_top_single))))

; An amount times a rate in basis points, rounded to the dollar.
(def mt-at-rate ((amount Money) (rate-bp Int)) Money :cite ((law "MCA" "15-30-2103")) (round-dollar (/ (* amount (int-to-float rate-bp)) 10000.0)))

; The Montana Ordinary Income Tax Table: below the top of the lower bracket,
; 4.7% of the income; at or above it, 5.9% of the income less the table's
; amount for the filing status.
(def mt-ordinary-income-tax ((y MontanaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "MCA" "15-30-2103") (doc "mt-dor-form-2-instructions-2025" "tax-rates")) (withs (top (mt-bracket-top y status) less (cond ((state-joint? status) (. y 'ordinary_less_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) (. y 'ordinary_less_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'ordinary_less_head_of_household)) (else (. y 'ordinary_less_single)))) (if (< income top) (mt-at-rate income (. y 'ordinary_low_rate_bp)) (clamp-zero (- (mt-at-rate income (. y 'ordinary_high_rate_bp)) less)))))

; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal taxable income,
; so the federal standard or itemized deduction carries over, and the federal
; filing status. North Dakota-specific additions and subtractions come from
; NorthDakotaInputs.
;
; The rules cite the law (N.D.C.C. ch. 57-38) and the 2025 booklet. The parts
; of the form and instructions they implement name them in
; sources/catalog/nd/2025.
; The tax from the tax table or the tax rate schedules. Below the table limit
; the table taxes the midpoint of the $50 row the income falls in, rounded to
; the dollar; at and above it the rate schedule applies to the income itself,
; to the cent.

"57-38-30.3") (doc "nd-tax-booklet-2025" "tax-table")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) rows (nd-schedule 2025 status)) (if (< ti (. y 'tax_table_limit)) (withs (step (. y 'tax_table_step) floor (* step (floor-float (/ ti step))) midpoint (+ floor (/ step 2.0))) (round-dollar (state-bracket-tax rows midpoint false))) (state-bracket-tax rows ti false))))

; Form NJ-1040, New Jersey Resident Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; New Jersey does not start from federal adjusted gross income: it adds up its
; own categories of income. The rules take each category from the prepared
; federal return, and take the pension exclusion, the property tax deduction
; or credit, and the credits as inputs.
;
; The rules cite the law (N.J.S.A. Title 54A). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/nj/2025.
; The tax through a rate schedule, as the schedule prints it: in the row the
; income falls in, multiply by the rate and subtract the amount shown.
(def nj-schedule-tax ((rows (Slice NewJerseyRateRow)) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "N.J.S.A." "54A:2-1")) (fold (fn ((acc Money) (row NewJerseyRateRow)) Money (if (> taxable (. row 'floor)) (round-cents (- (/ (* taxable (int-to-float (. row 'rate_hk))) 100000.0) (. row 'subtract))) acc)) #usd"0.00" rows))

; Line 43: the tax on New Jersey taxable income. Below the table limit the Tax
; Table applies; each row's tax is the schedule's tax on the middle of the row,
; rounded to the dollar. At or above it the Tax Rate Schedules apply.

"54A:2-1")) (withs (rows (nj-schedule tax-year status) ti (clamp-zero taxable) step (. y 'tax_table_step)) (if (< ti (. y 'tax_table_limit)) (withs (row-floor (* step (floor-float (/ ti step))) midpoint (+ row-floor (* step 0.5))) (round-dollar (nj-schedule-tax rows midpoint))) (nj-schedule-tax rows ti))))

; so: no tax, nothing paid, and a note citing the law the finding rests on.

; dividends ended for periods beginning on or after January 1, 2021.

; Form IT-201, New York Resident Income Tax Return.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: the federal income
; lines, federal AGI, the federal filing status and the dependents the federal
; return claims. New York modifications, credits, the MCTMT, the Yonkers
; surcharge and New York City and Yonkers withholding are inputs.
;
; The rules cite the law (N.Y. Tax Law). The parts of the form and
; instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/ny/2025.
; Rate applied to an amount, rate in thousandths of a percent, to the cent.
(def ny-rate-of ((amount Money) (rate-pcm Int)) Money :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "601")) (round-cents (/ (* amount (int-to-float rate-pcm)) 100000.0)))

; The tax on taxable income from a rate schedule as printed: the base of the
; highest row whose floor the income exceeds, plus its rate on the excess.
(def ny-schedule-tax ((rows (Slice NyBand)) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "601")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable)) (fold (fn ((acc Money) (row NyBand)) Money (if (or (> ti (. row 'floor)) (is (. row 'floor) #usd"0.00")) (+ (. row 'base) (ny-rate-of (- ti (. row 'floor)) (. row 'rate_pcm))) acc)) #usd"0.00" rows)))

; The rate, in thousandths of a percent, on the next dollar of taxable income.
(def ny-marginal-rate-pcm ((rows (Slice NyBand)) (taxable Money)) Int :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "601")) (fold (fn ((acc Int) (row NyBand)) Int (if (or (> taxable (. row 'floor)) (is (. row 'floor) #usd"0.00")) (. row 'rate_pcm) acc)) 0 rows))

; The fraction of the phase-in reached: the excess of New York AGI over a
; threshold, at most $50,000, divided by $50,000 and rounded to four places.
(def ny-phase-in ((y NewYorkYear) (agi Money) (threshold Money)) Float :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "601")) (withs (excess (min (clamp-zero (- agi threshold)) (. y 'phase_in_width))) (round-rate4 (/ excess (. y 'phase_in_width)))))

; Line 39: New York State tax. At or below $107,650 of New York AGI it is the
; rate schedule (the tax table below $65,000 of taxable income is figured from
; the same schedule, on the middle of each $50 row). Above it, the tax
; computation worksheets recapture the lower brackets' benefit.
(defworksheet ny-state-tax ((y NewYorkYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (agi Money) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "601")) (bind rows (ny-schedule status)) (bind joint (ny-joint-schedule? status)) (bind hoh (ny-head-of-household? status)) (bind first-rate (cond (joint (. y 'first_rate_joint_pcm)) (hoh (. y 'first_rate_head_of_household_pcm)) (else (. y 'first_rate_single_pcm)))) (bind first-ceiling (cond (joint (. y 'first_ceiling_joint)) (hoh (. y 'first_ceiling_head_of_household)) (else (. y 'first_ceiling_single)))) (bind scheduled (ny-schedule-tax rows taxable)) (bind recapture (fold (fn ((acc NyRecapture) (r NyRecapture)) NyRecapture (if (> taxable (. r 'threshold)) r acc)) (NyRecapture #usd"0.00" #usd"0.00" #usd"0.00") (ny-recapture status))) (line 1 "Tax on the rate schedule" scheduled) (line 2 "First worksheet: taxable income at the flat rate" (ny-rate-of taxable first-rate)) (line 3 "First worksheet: line 2 phased in from the rate schedule over $50,000 of New York AGI" (if (>= agi (. y 'recapture_agi_full)) line2 (+ line1 (round-cents (* (- line2 line1) (ny-phase-in y agi (. y 'recapture_agi_floor))))))) (line 4 "Later worksheets: rate schedule, recapture base and phased-in incremental benefit" (+ line1 (. recapture 'recapture_base) (round-cents (* (. recapture 'incremental_benefit) (ny-phase-in y agi (. recapture 'threshold)))))) (line 5 "New York State tax" (round-dollar (cond ((<= agi (. y 'recapture_agi_floor)) line1) ((> agi (. y 'flat_rate_agi)) (ny-rate-of taxable (. y 'top_rate_pcm))) ((<= taxable first-ceiling) line3) (else line4)))) (result line5))

; Line 34: the standard deduction for the status, or the itemized deduction
; when it is larger.
(def ny-standard-deduction ((y NewYorkYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (claimable Bool)) Money :cite ((law "N.Y. Tax Law" "614")) (cond ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY) (. y 'standard_deduction_joint)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE) (. y 'standard_deduction_surviving_spouse)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'standard_deduction_separate)) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (. y 'standard_deduction_head_of_household)) (claimable (. y 'standard_deduction_single_dependent)) (else (. y 'standard_deduction_single))))

; Ohio IT 1040, Individual Income Tax Return, for full-year residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status and the dependents the federal return claims. The
; Ohio Schedule of Adjustments, Schedule of Business Income and Schedule of
; Credits are not worked here: their totals are inputs. The school district
; return (SD 100) and municipal income taxes are separate returns.
;
; The rules cite the Ohio Revised Code (R.C. Chapter 5747). The parts of the
; form and instructions they implement name them in sources/catalog/oh/2025.
; Whether someone else can claim the primary taxpayer as a dependent.
(def oh-claimable? ((hh ret/Household)) Bool :cite ((law "R.C." "5747.025")) (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent))

; Whether someone else can claim the spouse as a dependent on a joint return.
(def oh-spouse-claimable? ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus)) Bool :cite ((law "R.C." "5747.025")) (all-of (state-joint? status) (. hh 'spouse.can_be_claimed_as_dependent)))

; The number of exemptions on line 4: the filer and a joint spouse unless
; someone else can claim them, and each dependent.
(def oh-exemption-count ((hh ret/Household) (status fed/FilingStatus) (tax-year Int)) Int :cite ((law "R.C." "5747.025")) (+ (if (oh-claimable? hh) 0 1) (if (and (state-joint? status) (not (oh-spouse-claimable? hh status))) 1 0) (state-dependent-count hh tax-year)))

; The exemption for each person, by modified adjusted gross income.
(def oh-exemption-per-person ((y OhioYear) (magi Money)) Money :cite ((law "R.C." "5747.025")) (cond ((<= magi (. y 'exemption_low_ceiling)) (. y 'exemption_low)) ((<= magi (. y 'exemption_middle_ceiling)) (. y 'exemption_middle)) ((< magi (. y 'exemption_cutoff)) (. y 'exemption_high)) (else #usd"0.00")))

; The tax on taxable nonbusiness income from the 2025 brackets, rounded to a
; whole dollar as the form is filled.
(def oh-nonbusiness-tax ((y OhioYear) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "R.C." "5747.02")) (round-dollar (cond ((<= income (. y 'zero_bracket_ceiling)) #usd"0.00") ((<= income (. y 'top_bracket_floor)) (+ (. y 'middle_bracket_base_tax) (/ (* (- income (. y 'zero_bracket_ceiling)) (int-to-float (. y 'middle_bracket_rate_bp))) 10000.0))) (else (+ (. y 'top_bracket_base_tax) (/ (* (- income (. y 'top_bracket_floor)) (int-to-float (. y 'top_bracket_rate_cbp))) 1e+06))))))
